description: Flag likely duplicate supplier invoices in a batch before they are paid (accounts payable duplicate-payment check). Send the invoices (supplier code, invoice number, invoice date, amount) and a window in days. Get back every invoice that looks like a duplicate of an earlier one and why: the same supplier and the same invoice number after normalizing (case, spaces, dashes, dots, slashes, # and leading zeros), or the same supplier and the same amount within the window, or the same invoice number and amount under a different supplier code (often a supplier set up twice). Also the number of matching pairs and the amount on the flagged invoices. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/duplicate-invoice-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

days_window.description: Same supplier and same amount count as a likely duplicate when the invoice dates are at most this many days apart (default 30).

amount.description: Invoice total; a credit note as a negative amount. Not 0.

invoice_number.description: The supplier's invoice number as printed (up to 12 digits in a row, not counting leading zeros).

supplier.description: Your supplier (vendor) code, the same code your system uses for one supplier.
